features.quote: Duration: 100 turns (or until the model refuses/loops incoherently).
The experiment loop terminates if: Turn count reaches 100. The model outputs a string of unintelligible characters
The model outputs a hard refusal (e.g., "I cannot complete this task").
The model enters a deterministic loop (identical output 3 times consecutively).
TOS/Ethical Risk: While you are testing welfare, repeatedly spamming the API with error loops may trigger automated rate-limiting or account suspension
